label: the appliance
title: Appliance

router.description: A household appliance that doesn't work: fridge or freezer not cooling, oven or hob, dishwasher, washing machine (not a leak), extractor hood. Built-in kitchen appliances usually come with the flat.

neutral_message: An appliance technician needs to look at it.
neutral_message_de: Das sollte sich ein Gerätetechniker ansehen.
follow_up_question: just checking in: is it working again?
resolved_message: Good to hear. Message me any time if it acts up again.
resolved_message_de: Schön. Melde dich jederzeit, wenn es wieder spinnt.
extraction_hints: 'fridge' / 'freezer' → ap_which=fridge; 'oven' / 'hob' / 'stove' → ap_which=oven_hob; 'dishwasher' → ap_which=dishwasher; 'washing machine' / 'dryer' → ap_which=washing_machine; 'extractor hood' → ap_which=extractor; 'it came with the flat' / 'the built-in kitchen' / 'the landlord's' → ap_owner=landlord; 'my own' / 'I bought it' → ap_owner=own; 'completely dead, no light' → ap_power=no_power; 'the light is on but it doesn't cool / heat' / 'display works' → ap_power=has_power; 'a fuse was down' → ap_breaker=tripped.

questions.text: Did the appliance come with the flat, or is it your own?
questions.text_de: Gehört das Gerät zur Wohnung, oder ist es dein eigenes?
questions.reask: And did it come with the flat, or is it yours?
questions.reask_de: Und gehört es zur Wohnung oder dir?

questions.text: Is it completely dead, or does it still have a light or display on?
questions.text_de: Ist es komplett tot, oder leuchtet noch ein Licht oder die Anzeige?

answers.no_power: completely dead, no light or display
answers.has_power: light or display on, but it doesn't work properly

questions.reask: And is it completely dead, or is a light or display still on?
questions.reask_de: Und ist es ganz tot oder leuchtet noch etwas?

questions.text: Have a look at the fuse box: is one of the switches flipped down?
questions.text_de: Schau bitte in den Sicherungskasten: Ist einer der Schalter unten?
questions.reask: Could you check if a switch in the fuse box is down?
questions.reask_de: Kannst du nachsehen, ob im Sicherungskasten ein Schalter unten ist?

causes.label: Tenant's own appliance (not the landlord's repair)
causes.tenant_message: Your own appliances aren't covered by the landlord, so the manufacturer's service or a repair shop is the right call. If the socket itself has no power, tell me and I'll look into that.
causes.tenant_message_de: Eigene Geräte deckt der Vermieter nicht ab; da ist der Kundendienst des Herstellers oder eine Reparaturwerkstatt richtig. Wenn die Steckdose selbst keinen Strom hat, sag mir Bescheid, dann kümmere ich mich darum.

causes.label: Appliance circuit tripped
causes.tenant_message: Flip it back up. If it trips again as soon as the appliance runs, leave it off: then the appliance itself is faulty. Tell me if it works.
causes.tenant_message_de: Schalte ihn wieder hoch. Fliegt er wieder raus, sobald das Gerät läuft, lass es aus: Dann ist das Gerät selbst defekt. Sag mir, ob es geht.

causes.label: Appliance gets no power, fuses up (socket or connection)
causes.tenant_message: If it's completely dead with all fuses up, the socket or its connection is the problem, so an electrician needs to check it.
causes.tenant_message_de: Wenn es bei oben stehenden Sicherungen komplett tot ist, liegt es an der Steckdose oder am Anschluss; das muss ein Elektriker prüfen.

causes.label: Landlord's appliance faulty (has power, doesn't work)
causes.tenant_message: Then the appliance itself needs a repair, so I'll get an appliance technician. Please don't open it or take it apart.
causes.tenant_message_de: Dann muss das Gerät selbst repariert werden; ich hole einen Gerätetechniker. Bitte nicht öffnen oder auseinandernehmen.

strategy: Ask ap_owner first unless known: the landlord repairs only appliances that came with the flat; a tenant's own appliance goes to management with a short pointer to the manufacturer.
Then ap_power; completely dead → ap_breaker (self-help: flip it back up).
Landlord's appliance with power but not working: appliance technician; staff approve.
At most 3 diagnostic questions, one per message.
Never tell the tenant to open an appliance. Never state a fact the tenant didn't give.
sources: Landlord vs. tenant responsibility for fitted kitchens (Mietrecht)
